title: Zombie
body:
The Zombie is an enemy added in the Halloween 2024 event. The Zombie can appear during a Blood Moon, which last 5 in-game hours or 5 minutes in real life. When killed, it drops 1-3 Bone, 1-3 Candycorn, and has a 30-50% chance to drop a Zombie Head. If a Zombie is wearing a Pumpkin, it will drop upon death.

It can spawn in the center of the Farlands (near the Lighthouse), the Taiga (behind Alan's Autologistics) and in the Savannah.
